probes.finding: cuSOLVER diagonal potrf is serial-latency-bound at ~0.33us/row (m=128..4096 measured 61.6/103.4/186.7/348.5/676.4/1537.9us, i.e. near-LINEAR not cubic). Total diagonal cost is therefore ~c*n independent of nb, so nb tuning is dead. All 12 PyTorch-op blocked replacements at m=2048 LOST to one cuSOLVER call (best blocked_leaf1024_tf32 1089us vs 676us = 1.6x slower; worst blocked_leaf256_invapply 2536us = 3.8x slower). TF32 inside the diagonal is strictly dominated (tol_frac 0.037 vs fp32 7e-5 AND slower).

variants.name: fp16-shadow + allocation/copy hygiene
variants.architecture: New 16384-only factor `_exp061_factor_1x16384` replacing `_factor_1x16384_trsm_free` at the n==16384 dispatch. Five mechanisms: (1) one reused (n-nb, nb) block-column scratch instead of a fresh `.contiguous()` allocation per step; (2) one reused, zeroed-once triangular-inverse buffer via new helper `_exp061_leaf_inverse` (every non-zero region is fully overwritten each call, so the per-step FillFunc disappears) with the tree's `neg` folded into baddbmm alpha=-1; (3) `torch.mm(..., out=<factor slice>)` so the inverse apply writes the factor directly instead of materializing a product and copying it in; (4) no block-column copy at all on step k=0, which has no update to accumulate; (5) a persistent FP16 shadow of the factor driving both the left-looking block-column GEMM and the inverse apply on FP16 tensor cores with FP32 accumulation. FP16 and TF32 carry the same 11-bit effective mantissa, so the shadow trades no precision for 1.71x measured GEMM throughput; only exponent range narrows and the shipped isfinite guard already routes overflow to the exact fallback chain. The cuSOLVER diagonal potrf is deliberately left untouched (see probe-01).
variants.checker: official checker PASS on all six families
variants.family_note: spectrum and lowrank take safety fallbacks. These are the INHERITED safety cases of ranked incumbent #906955, recorded in experiments/060-two-large-followup/combined-v1-family-comparison.json as `inherited_safety_cases` (1x16384 spectrum, 1x16384 lowrank, 1x32768 spectrum, 1x32768 lowrank, 1x32768 rowscale). Behaviour and residuals match the incumbent exactly; no new fallback family.
